name: Remove – Hide Price and Add to Cart
author: wpnote

sections.description:
The “Remove – Hide Price and Add to Cart WooCommerce” plugin provides an easy way to hide the price and “Add to Cart” button for selected WooCommerce products. This plugin is ideal for items you want to showcase without making them purchasable online, such as products on request or informational listings.

Key Features:
– Hide the “Add to Cart” button on single product pages and shop loops for selected products.
– Option to hide product prices while keeping inventory and price information available in the backend.
– Simple checkbox controls in the WooCommerce product Advanced settings.
– Works with both simple and variable products.
– Compatibility and Performance: Tested with the latest WordPress versions and optimized to not slow down your site.
– Compatible with WordPress >= 6.0 and PHP >= 7.4
sections.installation:
1. Go to your admin area and select Plugins -> Add new from the menu.
  2. Search for “Remove – Hide Price and Add to Cart WooCommerce”.
  3. Click install.
  4. Click activate.

short_description: This plugin allows you to hide the price and the 'Add to Cart' button for specific WooCommerce products.
